note: A screen, not an audit: questions worth asking and the data needed to answer them. No savings are computed; typical benefits are the cited sources' general wording.

questions.question: What source-labelled trip or interlock records apply to each rotating or fired machine, and what remains unverified?

evidence.text: equipment K-A reads "K-A Fictional compressor subject K-A"

where: site records: cause-and-effect matrix, HAZOP and LOPA reports
data_requests.how: Review existing cause-and-effect, governing requirements and configuration records for each named machine, with their revisions and applicability. Retain supplied trip/switch indications as candidates; a drawing label or an unrelated function does not settle the records or establish effective, tested protection. Missing model information is not evidence that installed protection is absent.

where: site records: source-labelled function identifiers, initiating measurements, final elements and protected-machine targets, shared scope and revisions; governing requirements and validation/test evidence where applicable
DCS/PLC configuration: existing configuration and its documented measurement/action/final-element identities, read through the approved site process
data_requests.how: Keep each machine in the review even where a switch or trip is supplied. Retain all explicit shared targets and supplied qualifiers; unknown or contradictory targets remain unresolved. Same-model text or nearby equipment does not prove function coverage. Record a responsible person or authority separately from protected-machine association; neither is inferred here. This requests record review, not a new test, safety design or operating action.

questions.decision_rule: A qualified site review may resolve the source-labelled machine/function associations and remaining record requests using applicable current evidence. A supplied trip, switch, cause/effect row or shared-function label alone establishes neither complete coverage nor installed protection adequacy. This screen grants no acceptance or authority and performs no safety validation.

typical_benefit.wording: Safety benefit; no energy source. Present it as a question to verify, not a finding.

questions.limits: P&IDs often leave trips to separate cause-and-effect records. Missing or unknown model evidence does not establish missing installed protection. Supplied associations, shared targets, revisions and contradictions require review; no machine, person owner, approval, tested condition or effective protection is inferred. C9 has no primary safety-design source cited in the catalog and remains a question for record review, not safety design, SIL assignment, a legal-compliance assessment or an operating recommendation.
